nota: Preguntas y SQL de referencia redactados por el autor del proyecto (no por un tercero). Las fechas son explícitas: ninguna depende de 'hoy'. 'original_question' enlaza con scripts/questions.py.

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes hay registrados?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas están vencidas?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes son de Colombia?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Colombia'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Colombia'

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el monto total facturado en USD?

sql.postgres: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM invoices WHERE currency = 'USD'
sql.oracle: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM invoices WHERE currency = 'USD'

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas están pendientes de pago?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending'

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas se emitieron en julio de 2026?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE issued_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND issued_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE issued_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND issued_date < DATE '2026-08-01'

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas vencen entre el 1 y el 31 de octubre de 2026?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE due_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND due_date <= DATE '2026-10-31'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE due_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND due_date <= DATE '2026-10-31'

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes se registraron durante 2025?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

questions.question: ¿Cuáles son los 5 clientes con mayor monto total pagado?

sql.postgres: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.full_name LIMIT 5
sql.oracle: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.full_name FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuáles son los 10 clientes con mayor monto de facturas vencidas?

sql.postgres: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(i.amount) AS overdue_amount FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY overdue_amount DESC, c.full_name LIMIT 10
sql.oracle: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(i.amount) AS overdue_amount FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY overdue_amount DESC, c.full_name FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuántas acciones de cobranza se han hecho sobre facturas vencidas, por tipo de acción?

sql.postgres: SELECT ca.action_type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM collection_actions ca JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = ca.invoice_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY ca.action_type
sql.oracle: SELECT ca.action_type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM collection_actions ca JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = ca.invoice_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY ca.action_type

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el método de pago más utilizado?

sql.postgres: SELECT payment_method FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, payment_method LIMIT 1
sql.oracle: SELECT payment_method FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, payment_method FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuántos pagos se registraron con cada método de pago?

sql.postgres: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method
sql.oracle: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el país con más clientes?

sql.postgres: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country LIMIT 1
sql.oracle: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuánto suman las facturas vencidas de cada país?

sql.postgres: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.amount) AS overdue_amount FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.country
sql.oracle: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.amount) AS overdue_amount FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.country

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el promedio de días entre la emisión de una factura y su pago?

sql.postgres: SELECT AVG(p.paid_at::date - i.issued_date) AS avg_days FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
sql.oracle: SELECT AVG(TRUNC(p.paid_at) - i.issued_date) AS avg_days FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el monto promedio de las facturas por moneda?

sql.postgres: SELECT currency, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM invoices GROUP BY currency
sql.oracle: SELECT currency, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM invoices GROUP BY currency

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la factura de mayor monto y a qué cliente pertenece?

sql.postgres: SELECT i.invoice_id, c.full_name, i.amount FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id ORDER BY i.amount DESC, i.invoice_id LIMIT 1
sql.oracle: SELECT i.invoice_id, c.full_name, i.amount FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id ORDER BY i.amount DESC, i.invoice_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes no han hecho ningún pago todavía?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id)
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id)

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes no tienen ninguna factura?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id)
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id)

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas se emitieron en cada mes de 2026?

sql.postgres: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM invoices WHERE issued_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND issued_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_date) ORDER BY month
sql.oracle: SELECT TRUNC(issued_date, 'MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM invoices WHERE issued_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND issued_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY TRUNC(issued_date, 'MM') ORDER BY month

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas tienen más de un pago registrado?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT invoice_id FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT invoice_id FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

questions.question: ¿Cuántas facturas vencidas tienen más de 60 días de atraso al 1 de octubre de 2026?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue' AND DATE '2026-10-01' - due_date > 60
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue' AND DATE '2026-10-01' - due_date > 60

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el cliente que más ha pagado en total?

sql.postgres: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.full_name LIMIT 1
sql.oracle: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.full_name FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la mediana del monto de las facturas?

sql.postgres: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) FROM invoices
sql.oracle: SELECT MEDIAN(amount) FROM invoices

questions.question: ¿Cuáles son los 3 clientes con mayor facturación total, incluyendo empates en el tercer lugar?

sql.postgres: SELECT t.full_name, t.total FROM (SELECT c.full_name, SUM(i.amount) AS total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.amount) DESC) AS r FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.full_name) t WHERE t.r <= 3 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.full_name
sql.oracle: SELECT t.full_name, t.total FROM (SELECT c.full_name, SUM(i.amount) AS total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.amount) DESC) AS r FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.full_name) t WHERE t.r <= 3 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.full_name

questions.question: Lista los métodos de pago utilizados, separados por coma y en orden alfabético.

sql.postgres: SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT payment_method, ', ' ORDER BY payment_method) FROM payments
sql.oracle: SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT payment_method, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY payment_method) FROM payments

questions.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de las facturas está pagado? Redondea a dos decimales.

sql.postgres: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM invoices
sql.oracle: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM invoices

questions.question: Para los clientes con más de 10 facturas, ¿cuántas facturas vencidas tiene cada uno?

sql.postgres: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
sql.oracle: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

questions.question: ¿Cuántos clientes tienen más facturas vencidas que pagadas?

sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) t
sql.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) t
